export function isLocale(value: string): value is Locale {
  return locales.includes(value as Locale);
}

export function getLocaleCookieName() {
  return localeCookie;
}

export function getDefaultLocale() {
  return defaultLocale;
}

export function translate(locale: Locale, key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>) {
  const value = messages[locale][key] ?? messages.en[key] ?? key;
  return typeof value === "function" ? value({ vars }) : value;
}

export function getLocaleTag(locale: Locale) {
  return locale === "uz" ? "uz-UZ" : locale === "ru" ? "ru-RU" : "en-US";
}

export function translateCategory(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  return translate(locale, `skin.category.${value}`);
}

export function translateRarity(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  return translate(locale, `skin.rarity.${value}`);
}

export function translateExterior(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  return translate(locale, `skin.exterior.${value}`);
}

export function translateKpiLabel(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const key = kpiLabelMap[value];
  return key ? translate(locale, key) : value;
}

export function translateKpiHelper(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const direct = kpiHelperMap[value];
  if (direct) return translate(locale, direct);
  const watchlistMatch = value.match(/^(\d+) items on watchlist$/);
  if (watchlistMatch) return `${watchlistMatch[1]} ${locale === "ru" ? "предм. в watchlist" : locale === "uz" ? "ta item watchlistda" : "items on watchlist"}`;
  const notifMatch = value.match(/^(\d+) fresh notifications$/);
  if (notifMatch) return `${notifMatch[1]} ${locale === "ru" ? "новых уведомлений" : locale === "uz" ? "ta yangi bildirishnoma" : "fresh notifications"}`;
  return value;
}

export function translateTransactionType(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  return translate(locale, `type.${value}`);
}

export function translateListingStatus(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  return translate(locale, `status.${value}`);
}

export function translateNotificationTitle(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Buy order filled": "notif.buyOrderFilled",
    "Steam connected": "notif.steamConnected",
    "Price alert": "notif.priceAlert",
  };
  return map[value] ? translate(locale, map[value]) : value;
}

export function translateNotificationBody(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Your M4A1-S | Printstream purchase was completed instantly.": "notif.buyOrderBody",
    "Trading is now unlocked for your account.": "notif.steamConnectedBody",
    "AK-47 | Redline moved up 6.4% in the last 7 days.": "notif.priceAlertBody",
  };
  return map[value] ? translate(locale, map[value]) : value;
}

export function translateTransactionDescription(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const exactMap: Record<string, string> = {
    "Card deposit": "txn.cardDeposit",
    "Mock deposit": "txn.mockDeposit",
    "Mock withdrawal": "txn.mockWithdrawal",
    "Marketplace commission": "txn.marketCommission",
    "Wallet deposit": "txn.walletDeposit",
    "Wallet withdrawal": "txn.walletWithdrawal",
  };
  if (exactMap[value]) return translate(locale, exactMap[value]);
  if (value.startsWith("Bought ")) return translate(locale, "action.bought", { item: value.slice(7) });
  if (value.startsWith("Sold ")) return translate(locale, "action.sold", { item: value.slice(5) });
  if (value.startsWith("Commission charged on ")) return translate(locale, "action.commissionCharged", { item: value.slice(22) });
  return value;
}

export function translateError(locale: Locale, value: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Login required": "error.loginRequired",
    "Authentication required": "error.authRequired",
    "Amount must be positive": "error.amountPositive",
    "Insufficient balance": "error.insufficientBalance",

    "Deposit failed": "error.depositFailed",
    "Withdrawal failed": "error.withdrawalFailed",
    "User not found": "error.userNotFound",
  };
  return map[value] ? translate(locale, map[value]) : value;
}

export function localizeSkin<T extends Pick<SkinCard, "slug" | "name" | "category" | "rarity" | "exterior" | "finishStyle" | "description">>(locale: Locale, skin: T) {
  return {
    ...skin,
    name: skin.name,
    category: translateCategory(locale, skin.category),
    rarity: translateRarity(locale, skin.rarity),
    exterior: translateExterior(locale, skin.exterior),
    finishStyle: translate(locale, `skin.finish.${skin.slug}`),
    description: translate(locale, `skin.desc.${skin.slug}`),
  };
}
